evidence_excerpt: ACP (Jan 2022): 2022 E&P investment projected at USD 4.4 billion; 2021 about USD 3.1 billion (exploration 0.52 + production ~2.57) (paraphrase).
reliability_notes: Most of the 2014-2024 decline had occurred before Aug 2022; 2014 was the last year of the commodity price peak (base effect).

evidence_excerpt: CGR: Resolución 0946 (5 May 2026) raised TES over-adjudication from 50% to 100%; short-term TES rates near 15%; maturities concentrated in 2026, 2029 and 2030 (paraphrase).

evidence_excerpt: Cambio column: 1,085 contracts for $1.78 billones citing T-302 between 7 Aug 2022 and 9 Jul 2026; 6 for $463 millones in 2022 and 332 for ~$557 mil millones in 2026; 94.3% via ICBF Regional La Guajira; SECOP data (paraphrase).
reliability_notes: Figures match the cited source. Source is an opinion-section piece, not an audited dataset; SECOP reconstruction pending.

evidence_excerpt: Invías (27 Mar 2026): 33,102 km goal is long-term and conditional on budget; 3,876 km (11.71% of goal) with 8.4% of projected resources; 2,415 agreements signed since 2023 (paraphrase).

evidence_excerpt: Invías via Semana (28 Jun 2026): 4,087 km intervened; 2,048 projects completed and 253 ongoing; 88.49% physical progress of projects; over $685,846 millones invested (paraphrase).
reliability_notes: 4,087/33,102 = 12.35%, matching the report. Convenio count/value differ from the report (2,354; ~$714,000 millones).

evidence_excerpt: El Espectador: 4,087 km of ~33,000 promised; CGR observations on SECOP publication and supervision (paraphrase).

reliability_notes: Independent of the report and prior to it. Matches the report's 5.8% for 2023. Execution rate depends on the metric (commitments vs obligations/payments) and on FNGRD transfer accounting.
